literal_meaning: যমের বাড়িতে যাওয়া (death god's abode to go)
figurative_meaning_en: To curse someone by wishing death upon them
example_sentences_in_bangla: তুই যমের বাড়ি যা, এত বাজে কথা বলিস না!
ওকে যমের বাড়ি যাওয়ার গালি দিয়ে চুপ করিয়ে দিল।
example_sentences_in_english: Go to Yama's house, don't talk such nonsense!
He silenced him with a curse wishing him to Yama's abode.
history: Derived from Hindu mythology where Yama is the god of death and his abode represents the afterlife.
note: This idiom reflects Bengali cultural integration of Hindu beliefs in everyday language.
